description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git's sparse checkout feature. It sets up repositories, manipulates sparse checkout configurations, performs checkouts, and verifies the correct behavior of sparse checkout operations using predefined functions and Git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test condition, executes the supplied commands, and checks for success.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Executes a Git read-tree command expecting successful completion.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a Git read-tree command expecting failure.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or streams for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given output or data is empty.
